# This file is automatically generated from cmake.toml - DO NOT EDIT
# See https://github.com/build-cpp/cmkr for more information

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include("cmake/cmkr.cmake" OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

project(rengine
	LANGUAGES
		C
	VERSION
		0.1.0
)

include(CTest)
find_package(SDL2 2.32.10 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
include(orchestrator/native/curl.cmake)
set(RENGINE_VENDOR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party")
find_program(RENGINE_NODE_EXECUTABLE NAMES node REQUIRED)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
if(APPLE)
  enable_language(OBJC)
endif()
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${RENGINE_NODE_EXECUTABLE}" RENGINE_NODE_PATH)

# The seam, once per graphics API. A game ships one backend and pays no indirection (charter
# D14b/D51); rEngine's desktop keeps --renderer a runtime switch (spec 126 decision 3), so it builds
# the pack more than once with its symbols renamed and dispatches between the copies. The rename
# headers are generated by tools/seam_prefix.py from the pack's own headers, and tools/design.py
# checks both that they match and that nothing unprefixed escaped into the archives.
set(RENGINE_SEAM_APIS opengl vulkan)
if(APPLE)
  list(APPEND RENGINE_SEAM_APIS metal)
endif()
foreach(api IN LISTS RENGINE_SEAM_APIS)
  set(RENGINE_GPU_TARGET_NAME "rengine_gpu_${api}")
  set(RENGINE_GPU_SEAM_BACKEND "${api}")
  set(RENGINE_GPU_FORCE_INCLUDE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native/render/seam_prefix_${api}.h")
  add_subdirectory(packs/gpu "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/packs/gpu-${api}")
endforeach()
# Normal variables shadow the pack's cache entries, so they must go before the UNPREFIXED pack is
# added below -- otherwise the plain rengine_gpu would silently become whichever copy came last.
unset(RENGINE_GPU_TARGET_NAME)
unset(RENGINE_GPU_SEAM_BACKEND)
unset(RENGINE_GPU_FORCE_INCLUDE)

# --- the Rust orchestrator (charter D57, spec 128) ---
# Corrosion is build tooling, pinned by full commit sha and fetched at configure into the build
# tree -- the same shape as the pinned cmkr bootstrap in cmake/cmkr.cmake, not a vendored compiled
# source (third_party/README.md records both). rust-toolchain.toml at the repo root pins the
# toolchain every cargo invocation under it uses.
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(corrosion
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion.git
  GIT_TAG 1499b14e4906a2890f5cee1547c8848db261753d) # v0.6.1
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(corrosion)
corrosion_import_crate(MANIFEST_PATH red/Cargo.toml CRATES red-core red-link)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  # Cargo runs from the workspace root so the rustup shim resolves the repo's rust-toolchain.toml;
  # the smoke tests prove the pinned toolchain builds and tests both crates.
  add_test(NAME rust_red_core COMMAND cargo test -p red-core WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/red)
  add_test(NAME rust_red_link COMMAND cargo test -p red-link WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/red)
endif()

# Subdirectory: packs/gpu
set(CMKR_CMAKE_FOLDER ${CMAKE_FOLDER})
if(CMAKE_FOLDER)
	set(CMAKE_FOLDER "${CMAKE_FOLDER}/packs/gpu")
else()
	set(CMAKE_FOLDER "packs/gpu")
endif()
add_subdirectory("packs/gpu")
set(CMAKE_FOLDER ${CMKR_CMAKE_FOLDER})

# Target: rengine_seam_opengl
set(rengine_seam_opengl_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"orchestrator/native/render/backend_seam.c"
	"orchestrator/native/render/seam_host_gl.c"
)

add_library(rengine_seam_opengl STATIC)

target_sources(rengine_seam_opengl PRIVATE ${rengine_seam_opengl_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${rengine_seam_opengl_SOURCES})

target_compile_definitions(rengine_seam_opengl PUBLIC
	SDL_MAIN_HANDLED
)

target_compile_features(rengine_seam_opengl PUBLIC
	c_std_11
)

target_include_directories(rengine_seam_opengl PUBLIC
	"orchestrator/native"
)

target_link_libraries(rengine_seam_opengl PRIVATE
	SDL2::SDL2
	rengine_microui
	rengine_gpu_opengl
)

set(CMKR_TARGET rengine_seam_opengl)
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(rengine_seam_opengl PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
  # The rename is derived from headers, so it can go stale; the archives are asked directly whether
  # anything escaped. A missed symbol does not fail the link -- it silently gives two renderers one
  # backend's function -- so this runs on every build rather than in a suite someone can skip.
  add_custom_command(TARGET rengine_seam_opengl POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/seam_symbols.py" "re_opengl_"
            "$<TARGET_FILE:rengine_seam_opengl>" "$<TARGET_FILE:rengine_gpu_opengl>"
    VERBATIM COMMENT "checking the opengl seam copy's symbols are all prefixed")
endif()

	enable_language(OBJC)
	target_sources(rengine_seam_metal PRIVATE orchestrator/native/render/seam_host_metal.m)
	# Without ARC, matching the pack's own Metal file: the host owns its device, layer and drawable in a
	# plain C struct with explicit retain/release.
	set_source_files_properties(orchestrator/native/render/seam_host_metal.m
	                            PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fno-objc-arc")
	target_link_libraries(rengine_seam_metal PUBLIC "-framework Metal" "-framework QuartzCore" "-framework Foundation")
	if(NOT MSVC)
	  target_compile_options(rengine_seam_metal PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
	  # The rename is derived from headers, so it can go stale; the archives are asked directly whether
	  # anything escaped. A missed symbol does not fail the link -- it silently gives two renderers one
	  # backend's function -- so this runs on every build rather than in a suite someone can skip.
	  add_custom_command(TARGET rengine_seam_metal POST_BUILD
	    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/seam_symbols.py" "re_metal_"
	            "$<TARGET_FILE:rengine_seam_metal>" "$<TARGET_FILE:rengine_gpu_metal>"
	    VERBATIM COMMENT "checking the metal seam copy's symbols are all prefixed")

# Target: rengine_plugin_fixture
if(BUILD_TESTING) # testing
	set(rengine_plugin_fixture_SOURCES
		cmake.toml
		"orchestrator/native/tests/plugins/fixture_plugin.c"
	)

	add_library(rengine_plugin_fixture SHARED)

	target_sources(rengine_plugin_fixture PRIVATE ${rengine_plugin_fixture_SOURCES})
	source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${rengine_plugin_fixture_SOURCES})

	target_compile_features(rengine_plugin_fixture PUBLIC
		c_std_11
	)

	target_include_directories(rengine_plugin_fixture PUBLIC
		"orchestrator/native"
	)

	set(CMKR_TARGET rengine_plugin_fixture)
	# PREFIX "" keeps each module's file name its target name, under ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins on every platform.
	function(rengine_plugin_output name)
	  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES PREFIX "" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins")
	  if(NOT MSVC)
	    target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
	  endif()
	endfunction()
	function(rengine_plugin_variant name)
	  add_library(${name} SHARED "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native/tests/plugins/fixture_plugin.c")
	  target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native")
	  target_compile_features(${name} PRIVATE c_std_11)
	  target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE ${ARGN})
	  rengine_plugin_output(${name})
	endfunction()
	rengine_plugin_output(rengine_plugin_fixture)
	rengine_plugin_variant(rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_old RE_FIXTURE_ABI=0 RE_FIXTURE_NAME="fixture-abi-old")
	rengine_plugin_variant(rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_new "RE_FIXTURE_ABI=(RE_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION+1)" RE_FIXTURE_NAME="fixture-abi-new")
	rengine_plugin_variant(rengine_plugin_fixture_list_new "RE_FIXTURE_DRAW_LIST=(RE_DRAW_LIST_VERSION+1)" RE_FIXTURE_NAME="fixture-list-new")
	rengine_plugin_variant(rengine_plugin_fixture_list_old RE_FIXTURE_DRAW_LIST=1 RE_FIXTURE_NAME="fixture-list-old")
	rengine_plugin_variant(rengine_plugin_fixture_decline RE_FIXTURE_DECLINE=1 RE_FIXTURE_NAME="fixture-decline")
	add_library(rengine_plugin_blank SHARED "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native/tests/plugins/blank_plugin.c")
	target_include_directories(rengine_plugin_blank PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native")
	rengine_plugin_output(rengine_plugin_blank)

endif()
# Target: rengine_plugin_test
if(BUILD_TESTING) # testing
	set(rengine_plugin_test_SOURCES
		cmake.toml
		"orchestrator/native/tests/plugin_test.c"
	)

	add_executable(rengine_plugin_test)

	target_sources(rengine_plugin_test PRIVATE ${rengine_plugin_test_SOURCES})
	source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${rengine_plugin_test_SOURCES})

		rengine_desktop_core
	)

	endif()

	if(MSVC)
	  target_compile_options(rengine_plugin_test PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
	else()
	  target_compile_options(rengine_plugin_test PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
	endif()
	add_dependencies(rengine_plugin_test rengine_plugin_fixture rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_old rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_new
	  rengine_plugin_fixture_list_new rengine_plugin_fixture_list_old rengine_plugin_fixture_decline rengine_plugin_blank)
	add_test(NAME native_plugin COMMAND rengine_plugin_test
	  $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture> $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_old> $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture_abi_new>
	  $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture_list_new> $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture_list_old> $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_blank>
	  $<TARGET_FILE:rengine_plugin_fixture_decline> "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/orchestrator/native/tests/plugin_test.c")
	if(WIN32)
	  add_custom_command(TARGET rengine_plugin_test POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
	    $<TARGET_FILE:SDL2::SDL2> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:rengine_plugin_test>)
